news.title: Elon Musk loses court battle against Sam Altman and OpenAI after 3-week trial
news.description: A jury in Oakland, California, ruled against Elon Musk in his dramatic court battle with Sam Altman and OpenAI.

news.title: Warren Buffett teased to CNBC a ‘tiny purchase’ in March. Berkshire filing may have revealed it
